notes.title: Little Kingdoms: Chapters 1-3 Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Hello! For this latest update, I made several improvements:

1. Graphic enhancements for a better visual experience.
2. Fixes for various UI bugs.
3. Integration with Steam, wishlist button in-game and future achievement support for the full game.
4. Refined unit death animations.
5. Extended the prologue with two additional chapters.

I appreciate your support and hope you enjoy these changes!
